column4: Archaic 'public declaration' sense with no example is obscure and only confuses a learner.
'Maleness' in the biological sense is a rare use and is effectively covered by the 'manliness' meaning, so this meaning is redundant and could confuse learners.
'Pecker' duplicates the 'penis (informal)' meaning of the same word.
The meaning 'fear' is archaic and confusing for learners (the word is vrees), while fruit and result are the real meanings already listed.
'To shoot off fireworks' duplicates the listed 'to fire off' meaning.
'Pervert' and 'creep' are near-synonyms for the same sense of viespeuk, so this duplicates the other meaning.
'In between times' and 'in-between' are essentially the same meaning, so this duplicates the other listed meaning.
in-between and "in between times" are essentially the same meaning of tussendoor, so this one duplicates the other.
to go away essentially duplicates the other meaning "to leave (informal)", and the example fits that one.
The 'proud' meaning of preuts is archaic and obscure today; modern Dutch uses preuts only for prudish, so it only confuses a learner.
Roti flatbread is not a meaning of pannenkoek; the real senses (pancake, fool) are already listed.
clupeid fish duplicates the main meaning "herring" and is a needlessly technical gloss.
'To trot slowly' is not a meaning of kakken; the real meanings (to defecate, vulgar) are already listed.
'To produce a swelling' is not a real meaning of bloeien and is obscure, confusing for learners.
Indisch in Dutch means Indonesian/Dutch East Indies, while Indian is normally Indiaas, so this meaning is wrong and the other entry covers the real sense.
'To mark' is not a real meaning of aanhalen (only 'to quote' with quotation marks), which is already listed.
The gloss is a truncated nonsense fragment and the real meaning, exemption, is already listed as another meaning.
The meaning 'difficult' for drommels is not real or standard; drommels means 'darned/damn' as an intensifier, so this sense is invalid and the example is unnatural.
'Charity' and 'alms' are essentially the same meaning of aalmoes, so this duplicates the other entry.
The sense 'to be covered by one' is not a real meaning of vleien and is obscure and confusing.
Vleien does not mean 'to convince' as a distinct sense; it is at most a shaky variant of flattering or enticing, which are already listed.
to fling is not a meaning of vleien; the other listed meanings (to flatter, etc.) already cover the word, and the rest is obscure or duplicate.
The reflexive 'become clean' meaning is invented and duplicates the existing 'to clean' meanings.
This duplicates the 'great flood' meaning, and 'spill' is wrong, so one entry is enough; the idiom 'na ons de zondvloed' can be illustrated under the remaining meaning.
Hobble is not a Dutch meaning of the noun hobbel (it is a bump or obstacle, figuratively a hurdle), so this is a wrong or duplicate sense.
Belgen is archaic and rare, and the 'to become angry' sense is the reflexive form, so this is obscure and only confuses a learner.
Roesten meaning 'to roost' is not a real Dutch meaning (that is 'roesten' only as rust); the example is about roosting, which Dutch expresses with 'op stok gaan'.
Calf is not a real meaning of kuis (a dialect/obscure sense at best); the word is normally an adjective meaning chaste, so this noun meaning only confuses learners.
Marble is not a meaning of the word kuis; the noun sense is invented or obscure.
Club is not a meaning of kuis in standard Dutch; this obscure noun sense would only mislead.
Act is not a meaning of afmeting; the only valid meaning, dimension, is already listed.
Pinch is not a meaning of aai and the archaic label makes it only confusing; the stroke meaning is already listed.
Hundreds and thousands is not a meaning of musket (that is muisjes), and the real meaning musket is already listed.
L'Écluse is a place name on a common word and does not belong as a meaning of sluizen.
The 'nasty job' sense duplicates the 'chore' and 'minor problem' meanings and is an archaic, confusing sense of akkefietje.
It largely duplicates 'to have an ailment' and 'to be amiss', and the example is clumsy.
'pilferer' is a synonym that merely duplicates the 'petty thief' meaning.
Crook and deceiver are the same meaning of bedriegster, so this duplicates the other entry.
The 'face' gloss is just a vague form of the façade meanings already listed, so it duplicates the others.
Kraker as chiropractor does not exist in Dutch (a chiropractor is a chiropractor or 'manueel therapeut'), so this meaning is wrong.
Potbelly duplicates the paunch meaning of the other entry.
Jealousy as a meaning of ijver is archaic and confusing, and the article 'de' is already correct (ijver is a de-word).
'Urge' is not a real modern meaning of ijver; it is archaic and overlaps with zeal/dedication, and the article de is correct.
'Stoet' means procession, not bread, so this meaning does not exist and the correct one is already listed.
Ara as a verb meaning 'give' does not exist in standard or informal Dutch; the word is only a noun for the parrot.
'Nekken' meaning 'to believe' is not a real meaning; it seems confused with the slang 'nek je?' and the other listed meanings cover real uses.
The 'genteel, stylish' gloss duplicates the existing meaning 'fashionable', so it adds nothing.
Joekel meaning 'dog' is an archaic/dubious sense (joekel is slang for a big thing or a dog only in old usage), and the whopper meaning is the real one, so the misleading dog meaning is dropped.
Verstrijken means to pass or elapse (time) or expire; 'to use up by smearing' is wrong (that is verstrijken in an obscure sense of smearing), and 'to run out' already covers the expected meaning.
prul does not mean nickname; this meaning does not exist and the real meaning is covered by the other entry.
prul does not mean turd; this meaning does not exist for this word.
Gloss 'house' merely duplicates the other meaning 'country house', which is the real sense of buitenhuis.
Binnenlands means domestic/internal, not 'inland', so this meaning is wrong and the item is better dropped.
The 'something invisible' meaning is rare and unnatural, and it essentially duplicates the main sense of invisibility.
